# EXTERNAL_QUERY on Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, whose types BigQuery converts as its PostgreSQL
# mapping documents:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/federated_query_functions.md
#
# tools/e2e connects us.postgres of the project test to an empty PostgreSQL server.

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1::smallint AS x')
=> "1"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 9223372036854775807::bigint AS x')
=> "9223372036854775807"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT NULL::integer AS x')
=> null

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT true AS x')
=> "true"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1.5::double precision AS x')
=> "1.5"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 12.34::numeric AS x')
=> "12.34"

# NUMERIC by default, which divides to 9 decimal places.
SELECT x / 3 FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1::numeric(10, 2) AS x')
=> "0.333333333"

SELECT x / 3 FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1::numeric AS x', '{"default_type_for_decimal_columns":"bignumeric"}')
=> "0.33333333333333333333333333333333333333"

SELECT IS_INF(x) FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1.5::numeric AS x', '{"default_type_for_decimal_columns":"float64"}')
=> "false"

SELECT CONCAT(x, '!') FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1.5::numeric AS x', '{"default_type_for_decimal_columns":"string"}')
=> "1.5!"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1.5::numeric AS x', '{"default_type_for_decimal_columns":"numeric"}')
=> "1.5"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT 'abc'::varchar(5) AS x''')
=> "abc"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT '{"a":1}'::json AS x''')
=> "{\"a\":1}"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT '\\x0102'::bytea AS x''')
=> "AQI="

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT '2026-01-02'::date AS x''')
=> "2026-01-02"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT '03:04:05.123456'::time AS x''')
=> "03:04:05.123456"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT '2026-01-02 03:04:05'::timestamp AS x''')
=> "2026-01-02T03:04:05"

# Retrieved as UTC.
SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT '2026-01-02 03:04:05+09'::timestamptz AS x''')
=> "2026-01-01 18:04:05+00"

# The connection ID's forms.
SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('test.us.postgres', 'SELECT 1 AS x')
=> "1"

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('projects/test/locations/us/connections/postgres', 'SELECT 1 AS x')
=> "1"

# BigQuery's documented metadata query.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT * FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'pg_class';''')
=> "1"

SELECT SUM(x) FROM UNNEST([1, 2]) AS x JOIN EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 2 AS y') ON x = y
=> "2"
